short_description: Find a continuous dry slot long enough for your run, walk or outdoor errand.
description: Find a continuous dry slot long enough for your run, walk or outdoor errand. Set latitude, longitude, your IANA time zone, required minutes and maximum hourly precipitation probability. A valid window has zero forecast precipitation and satisfies the probability limit for its entire duration. Data: Open-Meteo weather API under CC BY 4.0, https://open-meteo.com/. Use an appropriate plan for your use. Missing forecast hours break continuity.
